verdicts.reason: A shrinks the product can to a tiny speck at the bottom and puts the 'Longest Day Sale' banner in an illegible sliver next to it, so the key imagery and the sale banner are lost. The middle is also cramped while the lower half is dead space. B keeps the banner, can and logo prominent. Its flaws: the headline orphans 'last' on its own line, the legal text is nearly as prominent as the subcopy and wraps awkwardly ('Co., 2026.'), the CTA is oversized and jammed against the copy, and the bottom is crowded while the top-left banner placement feels arbitrary.
